MATCH (r:Recommendation {id: $rid})
        OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:OF]->(i:Intervention)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:ESCALATED_TO]->(o:Officer)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (own:Officer)-[:OWNS]->(i)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (ap:Officer)-[appr:APPROVED]->(r)
        RETURN r, i, o, own, collect({officer: ap.id, name: ap.name, at: appr.at}) AS approvals

MATCH (a)-[r]->(b)
            WHERE a.id IN $ids AND b.id IN $ids
            RETURN a.id, type(r), b.id, r.weight, r.confidence, r.lag_days, r.source

MATCH (e:Episode {id: $eid})
        OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(f:Forecast)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:IN]->(d:District)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:HAS_PROFILE]->(v:VulnerabilityProfile)
        RETURN e, f, d, v
MATCH (c:CropStage) RETURN c.id

MATCH (e:Episode {status: 'closed'})-[:FOLLOWED_PATH]->(p:CascadePath)
        WHERE e.id <> $eid
        OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:IN]->(:District)-[:HAS_PROFILE]->(v:VulnerabilityProfile)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Season {id: e.season_id})
        RETURN e.id, p.signature, p.node_ids, v.vector, s.year

MATCH (i:Intervention)-[:TARGETS]->(n)
        WHERE n.id IN $path_ids
        OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[o:HAD_OUTCOME]->(:Outcome)
        RETURN i.id, i.name, i.trials, i.successes, i.precedent_weight, i.last_trial_year,
               collect({episode: o.episode_id, success: o.success, year: o.year}) AS history,
               collect(DISTINCT n.id) AS targets

MATCH (a:Agent)-[:PROPOSED]->(h:Hypothesis {episode_id: $eid})
        WHERE h.status = 'defeated'
        RETURN h.id, a.id, h.path_signature, h.claim, h.reason, h.eff_confidence

MATCH (s:Source)
        WHERE s.id IN $ids
        RETURN s.id, s.title, s.url, s.provenance

MATCH (run:Run)-[s:STEP]->(n)
        WHERE run.tenant = $tenant
        RETURN run.id, s.order, s.agent, s.tool, s.ms, s.summary
